item.text: Time is nearly up; the pipe test deadlocks (my harness, not the implementation). I'll gate it so it can't hang future runs, and record it honestly.

This turn's work:

**Transport-layer gap (its tests are all TCP-only here)**
- Read `net_transport.go`/`tcp_transport.go` closely against the interface contracts: conn pooling (`getPooledConn`/`returnConn` + `maxPool`), `genericRPC` deadlines, `InstallSnapshot` size-scaled deadline on a dedicated connection, `listen`/`handleConn`/`handleCommand` framing including the heartbeat fast-path and the `LimitReader` snapshot payload, `sendRPC`/`decodeResponse` reuse rules, and the `netPipeline` in-flight arithmetic (`maxInFlight-2` vs `minInFlightForPipelining`). **No defect found** — it matches upstream.
- I attempted to *execute* that code without sockets via a `net.Pipe`-backed fake `StreamLayer` ([zz_audit_transport_test.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/zz_audit_transport_test.go)). My harness deadlocked (synchronous `net.Pipe` + connection-pool reuse interacting badly) — a flaw in my fake, not the implementation. I gated it behind `AUDIT_PIPE_TRANSPORT=1` so it can't hang the suite, and recorded it as inconclusive rather than dressing it up as a finding.

**Regression check:** the three audit tests now run clean (`go test -run 'TestAudit_...'` → ok, 22.7s), so the added diagnostics don't break the suite.

**Verdict unchanged:** still no concrete correctness defect. Provenance (byte-identical to official `v1.7.3`), the in-repo suite, static checks, the repeated `-race` sweep, the in-memory crash/restart test, and the randomized acknowledged-entries safety check all support that.

Honest status of coverage: the TCP transport tests and the `fuzzy` linearizability suite remain unexecuted; the transport layer has been reviewed by reading and has an unfinished (harness-broken) executed probe. All of that is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) with the raw logs under `work/logs/` and the diagnostic tests in the work copy.
